card.title: IPad 6 Touch Not Working or Ghost Touching Repair

source.title: IPad 6 Touch Not Working or Ghost Touching Repair

claims.statement: iPad 6 digitizer connectors are easily damaged; if they're fine, bending may have cracked touch IC solder balls—reflow, then replace.
If connectors and touch ICs are good, broken traces between them are not viably repairable.

procedure: Reflow touch ICs; replace if needed.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
